description: Skoll REVIEW MEDIUM-6 finding (PKIX-szmo.7 triage). In pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs around line 256, Deviation::new validates that justification and authorized_by are non-empty, but does not validate id or target_lint. An empty id creates a Deviation that cannot be looked up by ID. An empty target_lint creates a Deviation that silently matches no lint (inert but confusing). Fix: add non-emptiness checks for id and target_lint in Deviation::new, returning the existing DeviationAddError or a new validation error.
title: pkix-lint: Deviation::new allows empty id and target_lint
